title: Circle Receives Singapore Regulatory Approval for MiCA-Compliant Stablecoin
summary: Circle, the issuer of USDC stablecoin, has received regulatory approval from Singapore's central bank to operate its stablecoin under the new MiCA framework. This marks a significant milestone for the company's expansion in Asia.

title: Tether Announces $150M Investment in Emerging Markets
summary: Tether, the world's largest stablecoin issuer, announced a $150 million investment fund focused on blockchain infrastructure in emerging markets across Africa and Southeast Asia.

title: PayPal Expands PYUSD Stablecoin to European Markets
summary: PayPal's PYUSD stablecoin is now available in 15 European countries, enabling cross-border payments with lower fees. The company partnered with local banks for regulatory compliance.
